title: arnavkj1995/WEAVER
abstract:
WEAVER is an efficient, consistent and high-fidelity world model enabling state-of-the-art robot policy evaluation, improvement, and faster test-time planning.

# WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation Arnav Kumar Jain 1,2,* , Yilin Wu 3,* , Jesse Farebrother 1,4 , Gokul Swamy 3 , Andrea Bajcsy 3 [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13672) [ ](https://arnavkj1995.github.io/WEAVER/) [ ](https://x.com/arnavkj95/status/2066919523685380387?s=20) [ ](https://huggingface.co/arnavkj1995/WEAVER) [ ](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yilin-wu/droid_ood_data) [ ](LICENSE) --- We introduce WEAVER: a world model architecture that satisfies the three desiderata: (i) fidelity, (ii) consistency, and (iii) efficiency. WEAVER unlocks state-of-the-art performance across policy evaluation (ρ = 0.870 correlation with real-world success rate), policy improvement (real-world success rate improvement of 38% on top of the π0.5 robot foundation model), and test-time planning (real-world success rate improvement of 14% with a 5–10× speedup over prior WMs). ## 🛠️ Setup Create a Python 3.11 environment and install dependencies with `uv`. For optional logging and development dependencies: You can also run commands directly through `uv`: ## Model Checkpoints and Datasets Download all released checkpoints from [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/arnavkj1995/WEAVER): This downloads the `WEAVER`, `WEAVER-FT`, and `WEAVER-ReFlow` folders. Each folder contains `checkpoint.pt`, `config.yaml`, and `norm_stats_relabel.json`. The OOD evaluation dataset used in this work is available at [yilin-wu/droid_ood_data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yilin-wu/droid_ood_data).
